serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.clear Bot: Welcome back! You: Hi. Bot: Did you speak with the Landlord again? Are you two friends now? You: Something like that. He’s helping us get to the island. Bot: Really? That’s unexpected. #bot.Expression.sad You: It seems like he has some good contacts. I already gave him money to make it work. Bot: You gave him money? Are you sure about this? You: It’s too late to think about it now. I should’ve asked you before giving him 6 million $ Bot: You gave him 6 million $? You: Y-Yeah, now that you said, it does sound ridiculous. #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.happy You: But hey! He’s still around! He didn’t escape with the money so it’s a good sign! Bot: True! That does sound promising! When are we leaving? #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.sad You: Ugh…{{wi}} That’s the problem. He doesn’t want to tell me. Bot: Maybe he already lost the money… You: N-No, that surely isn’t the case…{{wi}} I think. You: He seems flustered about something but doesn’t want to tell me. Instead he gives me those stupid missions. Bot: Missions? Like what? You: I had to scare away a bunch of homeless people and now I need to kick out one of his tenants. Bot: That’s… Are you sure about it? You: I told him that’s the last mission and he agreed. #bot.Expression.clear Bot: Tell me about this tenant. Maybe together we will come up with something. You: I don’t know much. It’s some stubborn old guy that has a premium police subscription. He lives at 14C. Bot: Does he have a pacemaker? You: Yeah, we are not doing that. Any other idea? Bot: Hmmm… An automatic insulin pump, perhaps? You: Killing him is out of the question, ok? Bot: Diabetic coma isn’t technically killing. You: We are not hurting him. Bot: Then this might truly be a challenge. You: How about we scare him away? Bot: Any threats won’t be effective. If Landlord’s usual tactics are not working then it means that this tenant puts a lot of trust into his police force subscription. You: No, I meant literally scaring him away. Bot: I don’t think I get it. You: We are going to convince him that this apartment complex is haunted! #bot.Expression.sad Bot: Is that really going to work?
